title: card-skill big mode input
description: Personal Big: clean 3:4 paper, left-aligned complete Song type, a reading accent and semantic pauses. Supports up to six lines within measured output bounds.

design.description: Optional explicit compatibility palette name. Changes colors only; the default uses the sharp house tone.

tone.description: House color tone. Changes color tokens only and is ignored when design is explicit.

phrase.description:
Main body text. Use
for line breaks and word to highlight words. Example: 'Agent 不是
加了循环'

accent_words.description: Words from phrase to wrap in <span class="accent">. Only used when phrase doesn't already contain accent spans. Example: ['Agent']

ghost_char.description: Deprecated compatibility field; ignored by the personal style. No watermark is rendered.

font_size.description: Override auto-calculated font size (px). Auto-calc uses ≤10 chars→220px, 11-20→190px, 21+→160px.

attribution.description: Optional attribution line below the phrase. Example: '— Alan Kay'

logo.description: Optional path to a brand logo image. Omit for an unbranded output.

brand_name.description: Optional brand name in the colophon footer. Omit for an unbranded output.

reading_lines.description: Optional explicit reading plan. Text must reproduce the plain phrase exactly (whitespace excepted). Max 60 characters, one unique accent within one line. No automatic truncation or shrinking.
